abstract: Machine learning capabilities have become important strategic assets, yet little is known about how their technical characteristics affect the competitive advantage of the firms that build them. Through an inductive, multicase study tracking six early-stage machine learning ventures in an accelerator program, we explore how their phases of specialization and exploration may be constrained by properties of the underlying technology. Our findings show how training data, learning paradigms, and model outputs depend on one another and on the applications they serve, and how these relationships change over time. This interdependence shapes firms’ growth paths, alternately expanding or limiting the strategic options available to them. Characteristics that confer an early competitive advantage can constrain later growth. We discuss the implications for strategy research on competitive advantage and path dependence in machine learning ventures.

ob.ai_reason: 聚焦机器学习企业技术能力与竞争优势
ob.tldr: 通过对加速器中6家早期机器学习创业公司的纵向多案例研究，追踪其专业化与探索阶段，发现训练数据、学习范式和模型输出相互依赖并随应用演化；早期技术优势会形成路径依赖，既扩大战略选项，也可能限制后续增长。

title: Growth Paths in Early Machine Learning Ventures: Technical Configuration and Competitive Advantage Over Time
title_zh: 早期机器学习企业的成长路径：技术配置与竞争优势演进
